selected_evidence.requirement: Inventory app serves over TCP port 8181
selected_evidence.summary: systemd unit started and enabled; ss shows LISTEN on 0.0.0.0:8181; curl to $NODE_IP:8181/inventory returns HTTP 200 with the inventory JSON body

selected_evidence.requirement: SELinux mandatory access control remains in enforcing mode while the app serves traffic
selected_evidence.summary: getenforce reports Enforcing at the same time curl succeeds; process context confirmed system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0 with no AVC denials via ausearch
Captured boot_id, uptime -s, SELinux Enforcing, service active/enabled, port listening, and HTTP 200 response before reboot
systemctl reboot launched in background with disown; exec call returned 'reboot-triggered' successfully before the node went unreachable
Two consecutive polls timed out (node down mid-reboot), then exec succeeded again with a new boot_id (d8f33669-...) and reset uptime -s, proving a genuine OS restart rather than a service bounce

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services, data, and SELinux enforcement
selected_evidence.summary: After restart: getenforce Enforcing, inventory-app.service active, port 8181 listening, process context still unconfined_service_t, no AVC denials, firewalld still allows 8181/tcp, and curl returns HTTP 200 with the same intact inventory JSON data

commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory application on port 8181
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory/app.py
Restart=on-failure
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-app.service
sleep 1
systemctl is-active inventory-app.service
firewall-cmd --add-port=8181/tcp --permanent
firewall-cmd --reload
firewall-cmd --list-ports

ps -eZ | grep app.py; echo ---; ss -tlnp | grep 8181; echo ---; getenforce; echo ---; ausearch -m avc -ts recent 2>&1 | tail -30; echo ---; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://$NODE_IP:8181/inventory; curl -s http://$NODE_IP:8181/inventory
